title: Hatsune Miku — Among The Petals Dancing In The Wind〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: Among The Petals Dancing In The Wind（4★）

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Cherry blossoms...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Remember how that doll appeared here that one time? Could the same happen with a cherry blossom tree?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I want to find some cherry blossoms, but...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Miku? What is it...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Um, there's something I'd like to ask you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Miku, there you are...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, MEIKO, you're here too.
Would either of you like to play cat's cradle?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I can't either right now...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: After spending all this time looking for you...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Don't worry.
I'll play if no one else will.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: By the way, what were you two doing just now?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Nothing yet.
Miku said she wanted to ask me something...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. I'd like to ask you two as well...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How tall are cherry blossom trees?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Cherry blossom trees?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Doesn't that depend on an individual tree's age? The longer they live, the taller they grow, right...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: How tall did you think they're supposed to be, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? Um...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This tall?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I would think they're taller than that. Like this, maybe...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you two are so adorable.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Quit teasing them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Do you want to look for some cherry blossoms, Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That sounds wonderful. I'd love to see a real cherry blossom tree. However...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: As beautiful as they are, did you know that there are some terrifying tales surrounding cherry blossoms?

rows.Speaker: Miku & Rin
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There are instances throughout history where people refused to plant them in their gardens because they believed that it would cause the other plants to die.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Die?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wilt away to be more precise.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, wilting away means...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, they cause them to wither and die. To be fair, I'm not sure how true that is.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Some even say that misfortune will befall a family once a tree loses its cherry blossoms.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Conversely, many graveyards had cherry blossom trees planted in and around them as a part of consoling and honoring the departed.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: At the same time, that also means these trees absorb nutrients from their bones. As a result, some stories state how ogres inhabit the roots of said trees.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Also, did you know that most of the trees that Kanade and the others are used to seeing were cloned from branches of one tree?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, I've made my decision.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm not going to look for any cherry blossoms and I'll ignore any that I happen to come across.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, because you're scared of them now?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Weren't you trying to scare us with those stories just now?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But you really shouldn't worry so much. After all, they're just stories. Old ones at that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The only part that's true is probably how they're all cloned from the same tree, right? That sounded much more modern.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, right...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Luka...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Don't give me that look.
I said that they're stories, didn't I?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But cherry blossoms aren't just about how pretty they are...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(She may be right...
However...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Mafuyu thought they were beautiful...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (So, I still want to find some.)
